description: Source code defining the CKEDITOR.htmlParser.fragment class and its methods for parsing and manipulating HTML fragments.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.fragment
classes.description: Represents a lightweight HTML DOM fragment with methods for parsing HTML strings, adding nodes, and writing HTML output.

methods.name: fromHtml
methods.description: Creates a CKEDITOR.htmlParser.fragment instance from an HTML string, with optional body fixing.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a node (element, text, or comment) to the fragment.

methods.name: writeHtml
methods.description: Serializes the fragment to HTML using a writer, with optional filtering.

methods.name: writeChildrenHtml
methods.description: Serializes child nodes to HTML using a writer, with optional filtering.
